draft_en.subject: Alongside the Utepo industrial switches in your packages - three configurations from single units
draft_en.body:
Hello CCTVRoom team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 25 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Utepo industrial switches in your industrial security packages, three configurations from single units, FCC/CE/RoHS, EXW, 15-day validity: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based, -40 to 75 C - model STI-288GPM - $82.2 USD; commercial 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-28DGGPM - $84.1; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: which configuration do your industrial installs use most - DIN-rail PoE, or the rack unit in a closet?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
